family.name: Baby1
family.text: Congratulations! You have a son! Your monthly cost of living will increase by five dollars per month.

family.name: Baby2
family.text: Congratulations! You have another daughter! Your monthly cost of living will increase by five dollars per month.

family.name: Baby3
family.text: Congratulations! You have another son! Your monthly cost of living will increase by five dollars per month.

family.name: Da1
family.text: Ouch! My feet hurt. My shoes are  too small. Will you please buy me a new pair? They cost five dollars.

family.name: Da2
family.text: I'll buy new shoes.

family.name: Da3
family.text:
I have good news! I've been accepted
 to college. If you lend me $480.00 a year
 to help pay for school,
I can go. Will you help me?

family.name: Da4
family.text:
I''ve been offered another chance to teach scool in town, and I'd really like to take it. I'll miss everyone, but I'm looking forward to living in a big city. My train leaves in a few days. I'll write from Boston to tell you
how I'm doing.

family.name: DAW1
family.text: Now that I'm older, I can help you in the fields when you're busy. I may miss some school, but you'll finish the work faster and save money.

family.name: DAW3
family.text: Now that I've finished school, I can work full-time in the fields. I can work as hard as any worker you could hire.

family.name: DAW5
family.text: A very nice family in town wants me to live with them and work as a mother's helper. Now that I'm grown up, I want a chance to be on my own. May I take the job?

family.name: DAW7
family.text: Now that I'm older, I can help you in the fields when you're busy. I might miss some school, but you'll finish the work faster and save money.

family.name: Daw8
family.text:
I've just received my teaching certificate. 
I've been offered a teaching job in town.
I'd really like to take it, but it would mean 
moving to town. Will you let me leave home
and take the job?

family.name: Daw9
family.text: I've been offered another chance to teach school in town, and I'd really like to take it. It would mean moving to town. Will you let me leave home and take the job?

family.name: Dat5
family.text: I've applied to Oberlin College, in Ohio. Maybe someday I'll be able to teach college, as some women are starting to do. Soon I'll hear whether the college has accepted me.

family.name: DMail
family.text: Hello, neighbor. Starting this month, your mail will be delivered to your house.  Whenever there's a letter for you, the red flag on your mailbox will be raised. Your mail won't come to my store anymore, but I hope I'll still see you there often.

family.name: Sop1
family.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad you're sending your daughter to school this fall. My daughter Katie is starting school too. By the way, school supplies will cost three dollars per term.

family.name: Sop2
family.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad you're sending your son to school this fall. My son Jesse is starting school too. By the way, school supplies will cost three dollars per term.

family.name: Sop3
family.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad you're sending your daughter to school this fall. By the way, school supplies will cost six dollars per term.

family.name: Sop4
family.text: Hello, neighbor. I'm glad you're sending your son to school this fall. By the way, school supplies will cost six dollars per term.

family.name: Son1
family.text: I have good news! I've been accepted to study law at a college back east. If you lend me $600.00 a year to help pay for school, I can go. Will you help me?

family.name: Son3
family.text: Ma, Pa, I've made up my mind. I'm going to California to seek my fortune. Please don't worry about me. I'll write you as soon as I get there.

family.name: Son20
family.text:
Now that I'm married, I've decided to take
a job working at the railroad station.
Susie and I will live in a set 
of rented rooms in town.

family.name: Son21
family.text:
Now that I'm married, I've decided
to go into business in town. 
I'm buying the carriage supply store, 
and Susie and I will live 
in a small house nearby.

family.name: Son22
family.text:
I was always happiest on the farm. 
Now that I'm married, I'm going to
take over the neighboring farm. 
Whenever you need help, 
I'll be right next door.

family.name: Wed1
family.text: I'm so happy! My beau John has asked me to marry him. I said yes. I hope we can afford a big wedding.

family.name: Wed2
family.text: I have good news! My sweetheart Susie and I are getting married. I hope we can afford a big wedding.

doctor.name: Doc0
doctor.text: Neighbor, I suggest that you buy these items to make your home more healthful. Buy what you can afford now. You can get the rest later.

doctor.name: Doc1
doctor.text: Neighbor, your daughter has a fever and chills. I'll give her medicine and she'll be better soon

doctor.name: Doc2
doctor.text: Neighbor, your daughter has a fever and chills. I'll give her medicine and she'll be better soon. Please pay me $25.00 for my visit.

doctor.name: Doc3
